pharmacy_purchase_flag: 'true' when the description is exactly PHARMACY PURCHASES, otherwise 'false'
business_key_status: 'collision' when another record has the same entity, payment date, supplier, transaction number, purchase invoice number, expense type and expense area; otherwise 'unique_in_file'
transaction_has_multiple_lines: 'true' when the same transaction number appears on more than one record, otherwise 'false'
description: free text of the payment line; keep it exactly as in the source, including trailing spaces
